title: ui colour vision (schema 1)
description: ui/data/colour_vision.json: the colour-blind presets the HUD applies (docs/ui/hud-spec.md section 56; UI's proposal docs/ui/ui-colour-vision.schema.json). A preset remaps only what carries gameplay meaning: `map` gives a colour role (UiLook.ROLE_HEX, an upper-case name) its replacement hex, `lanes` the fighters' lane colours by neutral fighter id (copied from data/art/colour-vision.json, which Art owns). Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore. Cross-references in tools/lib/xref-art.js: ui-colour-choices (choices holds "off", has a preset for every other choice and no preset that is not a choice), ui-colour-lanes (a preset's lane colours are Art's aura colours for that vision, when data/art/colour-vision.json is present), ui-colour-alias (an alias names a fighter of Art's file).

choices.description: The settings choices, in menu order ("off" and a preset each).

fighter_alias.description: The roster ids the HUD sees onto Art's neutral ids.

lanes.description: The fighters' lane colours by neutral fighter id (ui-colour-lanes).

map.description: A colour role to its replacement hex.
